summary: Forms of a free level are sums of delta forms at classes c; at c, change basis by a short basis Y(c) of the lattice (`exists_short_basis_stdSpace`): the vectors A·weylEval(y), y with root-of-unity coordinates, span the weight space, and the delta forms with these values are short (integral entries; archimedean bounds from |Y| ≤ 6N(fn)²).

steps.claim: By the free-level isomorphism, every form is a sum over classes c of delta forms at c; it suffices to show each delta form at c lies in the span of short forms.
steps.lean: ⊤ := top_unique fun φ _ ↦ (freeLevelEquiv _ _ 1 free).3 φ ▸ sum_mem fun c _ ↦ by

steps.claim: For each g choose a short basis Y(g) of the lattice of I_n at g: g⁻¹Y integral (b) and all entries of absolute value ≤ 6N(fn)² at every complex embedding (hZ).
steps.lean: choose Y b hZ using exists_short_basis_stdSpace (n := n) h

steps.claim: For a ring map f : ℂ → R, A_f = (∏_τ det(f(Y(c^{e_τ}))))·weylRep_κ(f(Y(c))).
steps.lean:
let A {R} [NormedField R] (f : ℂ →+* R) := (∏ τ, ((Y (c.out ^ e τ)).map
    (weightEmbedding f τ)).det) • weylRep κ 0 ((Y c.out).map <| weightEmbedding f ·)

steps.claim: It suffices that for every vector y with root-of-unity coordinates, the delta form at c with value A·weylEval(y) is in the span: these values span the weight space (`ext_weylEval` with infinitely many roots of unity, A invertible).
steps.lean:
use (ker_mkQ _).le ((A (.id _)).mulVecLin.range_le_ker_iff (g := mkQ _ ∘ₗ deltaForm ..).2

    ((Set.Ioi_infinite 0).preimage (⟨_, Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp · ·.ne' |>.eq_orderOf.symm⟩)))
    (mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.2 (((Group.isUnit _).map _).smul _) _))

steps.lean:

    ∧ ∀ x, ‖f _‖ ≤ 1 := ⟨by simp [funext_iff, A, Units.smul_def, f.map_det, weylRep_map, weylEval,
    mulVec_apply_eq_sum, map_eval], fun x ↦ (f.isOfFinOrder (by simpa using o x)).norm_eq_one.le⟩
